title: Past Simple — went / met / watched
examples: Yesterday I went to the shop.
Last weekend I met my friends.
pattern: Subject + past form  |  irregular: go→went, meet→met  |  regular: watch→watched
explanation: Use the Past Simple for finished actions in the past. Many verbs are irregular (go → went). Regular verbs add -ed.
explanationIt: Usa il Past Simple per azioni finite nel passato. Molti verbi sono irregolari (go → went). I verbi regolari aggiungono -ed.
realUse: Yesterday I went to the station.
Last weekend I met my friends.
On Sunday I relaxed at home.

options: Last weekend I met my friends.
Last weekend I meet my friends.
Last weekend I meeting my friends.
Last weekend I meets my friends.
exercises.answer: Last weekend I met my friends.
exercises.explanation: Meet → met in the Past Simple.
